title: Three Cheetahs Vs Ostrich | Life | BBC Earth

segments.description: Wide aerial shot of rugged mountains in Kenya, introducing the habitat of elite big cat hunters [[00:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=2)].
Medium tracking shot of a lone cheetah pacing purposefully through the tall golden savannah grass [[00:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=20)].
Medium close-up shot of a coalition of cheetah brothers walking together, showcasing the strength of numbers [[00:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=38)].
Medium shot of the three cheetah brothers stalking through high brush, demonstrating their cooperative hunting tactics [[01:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=72)].
Close-up shot of a large ostrich foraging in the grass unaware of nearby danger [[01:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=91)].
Medium close-up shot of the cheetah brothers intently observing their formidable target from the tall grass [[01:53](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=113)].
Medium action shot of the cheetahs suddenly breaking cover and launching into a high-speed pursuit [[02:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=158)].
Dynamic wide tracking shot of the three cheetahs sprinting across the savannah landscape in hot pursuit of the ostrich [[02:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=166)].
Medium action shot of the cooperative struggle as all three cheetahs tackle and wrestle the powerful bird to the ground [[03:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=206)].
Close-up shot of the cheetahs securing their victory over the ostrich, concluding the wildlife documentary segment [[03:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pkhE14Rou-E&t=224)].
